meta.title: NextToolbar docs
meta.description: A floating debug toolbar for the Next.js App Router: status, route, render mode, timings, fetch cache and a request profiler.

index.title: Introduction
index.description: What NextToolbar is, what it shows and when to use it.

getting-started.title: Getting started
getting-started.description: Install the package, add it to your root layout and run next dev.

configuration.title: Configuration
configuration.description: The theme prop, the recommended next.config options, basePath and assetPrefix.

toolbar.title: The toolbar
toolbar.description: Every segment of the bar, its hover panel, minimizing and themes.

profiler.title: Request profiler
profiler.description: The per-request panel: summary, errors, fetches, timeline and Clear.

render-mode.title: Render mode
render-mode.description: How Static, Dynamic and Static? are decided, and why dev can be wrong.

fetch-cache.title: Fetch cache
fetch-cache.description: HIT, HMR, MISS and SKIP, the hit rate and the cache reasons.

server-actions.title: Server Actions
server-actions.description: Every action call from the page: status, time, what it revalidated and where it redirected. Plus a Refresh button.

seo.title: SEO
seo.description: The metadata that actually reached the page, and what search engines and link previews trip over.

security.title: Security
security.description: Known vulnerabilities of your Next.js version, from GitHub's security advisories, and what to upgrade to.

compatibility.title: Compatibility
compatibility.description: What works on Next.js 15 and 16, and which browsers are supported.

architecture.title: How it works
architecture.description: Architecture, data sources, the HMR socket and a map of the source files.

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting & FAQ
troubleshooting.description: Known limitations and fixes for common problems.

design.title: Design
design.description: Design tokens, the primary gradient, light and dark themes, icons and the logo.

contributing.title: Contributing
contributing.description: Monorepo layout, the playground, tests, these docs and releasing.

demo.title: Live demo
demo.description: The real toolbar, running on simulated requests. Pick a scenario and explore the bar at the bottom of the page.
demo.simulated: NextToolbar only runs in next dev. This page feeds the same component with sample data, so you can try it without installing anything.

try.hover: Hover (or Tab to) any segment of the bar to open its panel.
try.profiler: Click the request id (#) to open the profiler: every request, its fetches and a render timeline.
try.errors: In the 500 scenario, open the errors panel and click Details.
try.actions: In "Account", hover the lightning: three Server Action calls, one of them failed. Clear empties the list.
try.seo: In "Blog post", hover the SEO segment: a title that's too long, no description and an og:image that returns 404.
try.security: In "Outdated Next.js", hover the red shield: known vulnerabilities of 16.2.6 and the version to upgrade to.
try.minimize: Minimize it with the logo or the close button, then click the circle.
try.theme: Switch the theme with the button on the right.

blog.description: A dynamic segment with two cached fetches, reached by client navigation.
